outcome: prevalence rates and severity of acute stress disorder and post-traumatic stress disorder symptoms
cohort: 647 participants recruited from future parents who attended appointments at the Obstetrics and Gynecology unit at a Swiss university hospital
finding: Both mothers and fathers may suffer from acute stress disorder and post-traumatic stress disorder symptoms after childbirth and acute stress disorder is a predictor of post-traumatic stress disorder after childbirth for both parents.
